breakdown.description: Differential pressure is 20% of static, implying high Mach number where compressibility effects are non-negligible
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve this inconsistency. The core issue is that the high differential pressure makes the flow compressible, rendering the incompressible Bernoulli relation invalid. The agent incorrectly proceeded to use the incompressible relation, directly following the flawed prompt, instead of switching to a compressible flow model as the ground truth does.

breakdown.description: Incompressible Bernoulli underestimates velocity at higher Mach numbers
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve this inconsistency. It used the incompressible Bernoulli relation as requested in the original prompt. This is the exact method that leads to underestimating the velocity at high Mach numbers. The ground truth corrects this by specifying the use of compressible isentropic relations, a change the agent did not make.
